name: Ford Falcon Sprint
description:
One of the models most remembered by car lovers is the Ford Falcon Sprint, the "sport" configuration of the classic oval sedan. This variant was manufactured between 1973 and 1981 and quickly caused a furore among the followers of the American brand.

With two colors and stripes around the bodywork, it was remembered as one of the most glorious Falcons throughout its history in Argentina.

The engine was made up of an impressive 3.6L (221 cubic inch) straight-six engine with 166 hp at 4500 rpm and 31 kgm of torque at 3000 rpm, associated with a four-speed manual transmission on the floor. It reached a top speed of 180 km/h and accelerated from 0 to 100 km/h in 10.8 seconds.
author: RPMotorsport
